macroModel.rateFormula: Weighted sum of each 3/6/12-month driver composite. Scores are model signals, not observed facts or market predictions.

drawdownModel.formula: Fund composite DD = 60% authoritative underlying target/proxy-vehicle historical downside input + 40% forward-looking median drawdown for that same documented vehicle. Nasdaq uses older U.S. JEPQ as a strategy-history proxy while preserving IE000U9J8HX9 as the actual target. Money Market uses its own fund because it has no target. Portfolio DD applies allocation weights and correlations.

funds.historicalBasis: Official ATRAM A PHP NAV maximum drawdown from 3,076 records, 16 Dec 2013 to 11 Aug 2026; the standalone UITF has no target vehicle.
funds.forwardBasis: ATRAM Peso Money Market Fund A PHP 10-year scenario median; model assumption because the fund has no target vehicle.

funds.historicalBasis: Official Fidelity target A-ACC-USD (ISIN LU1046421795) largest manager-published calendar-year loss, 2022. This is a transparent downside proxy because the manager factsheet does not publish a full daily maximum-drawdown series.
funds.forwardBasis: Fidelity Global Technology Fund A-ACC-USD (ISIN LU1046421795) 10-year scenario median; model assumption.

funds.historicalBasis: Official U.S.-listed JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Income ETF (JEPQ, CUSIP 46654Q203) daily NAV maximum drawdown from 1,072 manager-published observations, 4 May 2022 to 12 Aug 2026; peak 19 Feb 2025, trough 8 Apr 2025. This raw-NAV measure is not distribution-adjusted. JEPQ is the longer-history strategy proxy because actual UCITS target IE000U9J8HX9 launched in 2024.
funds.historicalMetric: JEPQ proxy daily raw-NAV maximum drawdown
funds.forwardBasis: U.S.-listed JEPQ strategy-proxy 10-year scenario median; model assumption. ATRAM's actual target remains JPM Nasdaq Equity Premium Income Active UCITS ETF USD (dist), ISIN IE000U9J8HX9.

slides.title: ATRAM Peso Money Market Fund - A PHP
slides.thesis: The required A PHP liquidity sleeve. It supplies rebalancing capital and risk capacity rather than the portfolio's primary growth.

slides.title: ATRAM Global Technology Feeder Fund - A PHP
slides.thesis: Both sides of the 60/40 DD composite look through to the exact Fidelity target share class. The 23.50% historical input is the largest loss in the manager-published annual series and remains labelled as a proxy rather than exact daily MDD.

slides.title: ATRAM Nasdaq Equity Income Feeder Fund - A PHP
slides.thesis: The actual target remains the newer JPM UCITS ETF, while the 60/40 DD model uses older U.S.-listed JEPQ as a disclosed strategy-history proxy. The authoritative daily NAV MDD is used and clearly flagged as not distribution-adjusted.

monitor.holding: ATRAM Peso Money Market Fund - A PHP
monitor.trigger: Investigate as not relevant if the verified net yield remains below the portfolio liquidity hurdle for two quarterly reviews, or the mandate/duration changes materially.
monitor.cadence: Daily source check; monthly yield review; quarterly mandate review

monitor.holding: ATRAM Global Technology Feeder Fund - A PHP
monitor.trigger: Investigate as not relevant if the target mandate drifts from global technology, verified all-in fees defeat the net forecast, or the 12-month technology signal remains below 3.0 while portfolio DD breaches its cap.
monitor.cadence: Daily source check; monthly macro/fee review; quarterly overlap review

monitor.trigger: Investigate as not relevant if technology exposure falls materially below the stated mandate, persistent earnings deterioration breaks the forward case, or concentration risk no longer earns its fee-adjusted return.
monitor.cadence: Monthly factsheet; quarterly holdings and mandate review

monitor.holding: ATRAM Nasdaq Equity Income Feeder Fund - A PHP
monitor.trigger: Investigate as not relevant if distribution or covered-call implementation changes materially, verified fees defeat the net forecast, or upside participation remains impaired without compensating income.
monitor.cadence: Daily source check; monthly distribution/volatility review; quarterly prospectus review

monitor.holding: JPM Nasdaq Equity Premium Income target ETF
monitor.trigger: Investigate as not relevant if the options overlay no longer supports income/volatility objectives, benchmark exposure drifts materially, or liquidity and tracking behavior deteriorate persistently.
monitor.cadence: Monthly ETF data; quarterly strategy and expense review

monitor.status: Relevant as DD proxy - not the ATRAM target
